event Borrow(address indexed user, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 borrowRate)
event InterestAccrued(address indexed token, uint256 supplyRate, uint256 borrowRate)
event Liquidate(address indexed liquidator, address indexed user, address indexed collateralToken, uint256 collateralAmount, uint256 debtAmount)
event MarketCreated(address indexed token, uint256 collateralFactor)
event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner)
event Repay(address indexed user, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 borrowRate)
event Supply(address indexed user, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 exchangeRate)
event Withdraw(address indexed user, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 exchangeRate)

function getMarket(address token) view returns (tuple(address token, uint256 totalSupply, uint256 totalBorrow, uint256 supplyRate, uint256 borrowRate, uint256 exchangeRate, uint256 lastUpdateTime, bool isActive, uint256 collateralFactor)) @1100000
function getUserPosition(address user, address token) view returns (tuple(uint256 supplied, uint256 borrowed, uint256 lastUpdateTime, bool isActive)) @1100000
function getUserTotals(address user) view returns (uint256 collateral, uint256 borrow) @1100000
function liquidate(address user, address collateralToken, address debtToken, uint256 debtAmount) @1100000

function markets(address) view returns (address token, uint256 totalSupply, uint256 totalBorrow, uint256 supplyRate, uint256 borrowRate, uint256 exchangeRate, uint256 lastUpdateTime, bool isActive, uint256 collateralFactor) @1100000
function userPositions(address, address) view returns (uint256 supplied, uint256 borrowed, uint256 lastUpdateTime, bool isActive) @1100000
